entries.c0d3b165adaea6e5: As a specialist maker of electrical control equipment, it states that it considers the keyword for surviving the times to be “co-creation and co-existence,” a relationship in which it improves its technological capability through its own ingenuity, competes and cooperates with users, and provides the best products responding to social trends and user needs. In R&D, its policy is to quickly develop and deliver high-quality new products that meet user needs, through a close collaboration system between sales and engineering.
